RETENTION.TITLE: Retention space

EMPTY.active: No active sessions. Search for a customer to start a retention conversation.
EMPTY.search: Find a Telegram conversation by name, username, Telegram ID or conversation number.
EMPTY.history: Completed sessions appear here as saved, read-only snapshots.

RETENTION.NO_ACCESS: This space is available to the retention specialists selected in Settings → Account settings.
RETENTION.ERROR: Could not load or save the conversation. Your draft is kept. Refresh and try again.
RETENTION.ACTIVE_NOTE: Only retention specialists can access this active conversation. Its messages are excluded from support automations and tracking. Completing saves a snapshot and returns it to the archive.
RETENTION.PREVIEW_NOTE: Preview only. Your first message starts a retention session and moves this conversation out of support.
RETENTION.SNAPSHOT: Saved snapshot · {date}. This transcript is read-only.
RETENTION.SEND_HINT: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
RETENTION.SELECT: Select a session, or search for a customer to start one.
RETENTION.FILE_UNAVAILABLE: Original file unavailable. Saved metadata is kept.
RETENTION.UPLOAD_COUNT: Select up to 15 files to send.
RETENTION.UPLOAD_SIZE: Each file must be smaller than {limit} MB.
RETENTION.DELIVERY_FAILED: Delivery failed. This message was not sent.
RETENTION.DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete this message from Telegram and the retention chat?
RETENTION.DELETE_UNSENT_CONFIRM: Remove this unsent message from the retention chat?
RETENTION.SNAPSHOT_PENDING: Session saved and chat archived. The snapshot is syncing to History; it will open automatically.
